quizName:
Hardest Questions in New mexico
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for what is coming. This sign tells you there is a stop sign ahead. You should slow down and get ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to what is ahead. This sign warns you that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through it means the action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: When stopped by police for a traffic violation or equipment check, you must show:
questions.explanation: You must always have your license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance in your vehicle. You must show all three documents when stopped by police.

questions.question: If you get tired while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Stop to rest or change drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop to rest or change drivers.
questions.explanation: If you are tired, stop to rest or let someone else drive. Tiredness slows your thinking and reactions, which makes driving unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that bicycles may cross the road at this location. Watch for bike traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on streets where you cannot enter. You might see it at the wrong end of a one-way street or ramp.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield to oncoming traffic when turning left at a green light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to oncoming traffic when turning left at a green light.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that when turning left on a green light, you must let oncoming traffic pass first. You can turn left when it is safe.

questions.question: Like alcohol and drugs, drowsiness can:
questions.explanation: Lack of sleep causes poor driving. Drowsiness slows your reaction time, reduces awareness, and impairs judgment—just like alcohol and drugs.

questions.question: If you need to stop suddenly on an interstate, you should:

options.text: Sound your horn to get other drivers' attention.
Get out and flag down the first passing vehicle.
Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle if possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull off the road, turn on your emergency flashers, and stay in your vehicle if possible.
questions.explanation: If you must stop on an interstate shoulder, turn on your emergency flashers and stay inside your vehicle. Standing or walking on an interstate is very dangerous because traffic moves at high speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to watch for bicycles, animals, or pedestrians that may cross the road.

questions.question: Distracted driving can be caused by:

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.
Changing the radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers must make 200 decisions per mile. You need full attention on driving. Any extra task can be dangerous.

questions.question: If you are angry after an argument, you should:

options.text: Play loud music so you do not think about it while driving.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Drive on the interstate to calm down.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: Emotions affect your driving. If you are angry, excited, afraid, worried, or sad, calm down before driving. You must focus fully on driving.

questions.question: You should reduce your speed when:
questions.explanation: Only drive at the speed limit in perfect conditions. Slow down when roads are icy, snowy, rainy, or foggy.

questions.question: Driving ability can be impaired by:
questions.explanation: Safe driving depends on your physical condition. Alcohol, legal and illegal drugs, and drowsiness can all impair your driving ability.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to let traffic from the right merge into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to let traffic from the right merge into your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What should you do at a railroad crossing with lowered gates and flashing lights?

options.text: Drive around the crossing gates if you cannot see a train.
Stop well behind the gates. Wait until the gates lift and the tracks are clear, then proceed.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop well behind the gates. Wait until the gates lift and the tracks are clear, then proceed.
questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing when gates are lowered or warning lights flash. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect your driving?
questions.explanation: Alcohol affects judgment, self-control, and reaction time. It also impairs coordination, balance, vision, and your ability to judge distance.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign shows a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to stay safe and protect your brakes.
